disclaimer: This is a synthetic IT general-controls review of fictional Northstar systems. It is not a SOX audit opinion.

controls.title: User access provisioning
controls.objective: New workforce access is granted only after manager and IAM approval.

controls.title: User access termination
controls.objective: Access is revoked within 24 hours of HR recording a termination.

controls.title: Periodic access reviews
controls.objective: System owners review all active accounts at least quarterly and record sign-off.

controls.title: Privileged access
controls.objective: Privileged roles require dual approval and MFA enrollment before use.

controls.title: Change approvals
controls.objective: Production changes are approved by CAB or two independent approvers before implementation.

controls.title: Deployment authorization
controls.objective: Production deployments reference an approved change ticket.

controls.title: Production change documentation
controls.objective: Each production change records implementation steps, backout, and post-implement evidence.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.objective: The same person cannot develop a production change and approve it.

controls.title: Incident and exception tracking
controls.objective: Sev 1 and Sev 2 incidents are logged, and control exceptions have tickets.

controls.title: Evidence completeness
controls.objective: The period evidence package contains every artifact named in the control catalog.

controls.title: Emergency change follow-up
controls.objective: Emergency production changes receive documented post-implementation approval within two business days.
